name: CISTUS CANADENSIS
key_symptoms: Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Cool feeling in whole abdomen. Desire for cheese.
Coldness in chest. The neck is studded with tumors. Induration of mammæ. Hæmorrhage from lungs.
Asthmatic after lying down (trachea feels narrow), preceded by formication.
Sprained pain in wrist. Tips of fingers sensitive to cold. Tetter on hands. Cold feet. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs, with hard swelling around. White swelling.
guiding_symptoms: Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Cool feeling in whole abdomen. Desire for cheese.
Coldness in chest. The neck is studded with tumors. Induration of mammæ. Hæmorrhage from lungs.
Asthmatic after lying down (trachea feels narrow), preceded by formication.
head_symptoms: Watery discharge; also fetid pus. Tetter on and around ears, extending to external meatus.
respiratory_symptoms: Asthmatic after lying down (trachea feels narrow), preceded by formication.
gi_symptoms: Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Cool feeling in whole abdomen. Desire for cheese.
urinary_symptoms: Induration and inflammation of mammæ. Sensitive to cold air. Bad smelling leucorrhœa.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Sprained pain in wrist. Tips of fingers sensitive to cold. Tetter on hands. Cold feet. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs, with hard swelling around. White swelling.
skin_symptoms: Itching all over. Small, painful pimples; lupus. Glands inflamed and indurated. Mercurio-syphilitic ulcers. Skin of hands hard, thick, dry, fissured; deep cracks. Itching of swollen hands and arms; general itching which presents sleep. Hemicrania.
sleep_symptoms: Cannot sleep from coldness in throat.

source.title: CISTUS CANADENSIS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
